The woman introduces the first category for oily skin with large pores, displaying a picture of skin texture. She recommends La Roche-Posay Effaclar Supramolecular Oil and Pores Correct, explaining that it has a matte finish, does not interfere with makeup, and helps blur pores while controlling oil.

Continuing the oily skin category, the speaker recommends INGU Green Tea Soothing Aqua Gel with Biome Balance. She explains that this gel-texture moisturizer helps reduce skin temperature, provides lasting hydration, strengthens the skin barrier, and cares for skin balance.

The video transitions to category two for soothing and calming the skin, featuring an image of a woman with a sheet mask. The speaker recommends Dr.G R.E.Blemish Clear Soothing Cream, noting its effectiveness in soothing sensitive skin and keeping it moisturized and strong.

The speaker introduces Purito Seoul Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream as another option for skin soothing. She describes it as a lightweight cream that provides great comfort to the skin and excels at taking care of inflammation.
The speaker suggests MizuMi Cica Soothing Moisture Gel for those looking for a lower budget option in the soothing category. She highlights its great hydration and excellent ability to calm skin.

Moving to category three for acne-prone skin, with accompanying images of a woman applying serum, the speaker recommends SKINPRO Rx Sensitive Skin Moisturizing Cream. She explains that it balances skin, strengthens the skin barrier, and helps manage inflammation without causing clogging.

The speaker introduces AMT Light Emulsion as an acne-prone skin recommendation for those with a higher budget. She states that it helps strengthen skin and brighten complexion, making it suitable for skin that is oily outside but dry inside.

The speaker presents category four for moisturizers used before makeup, showing a woman applying cream in front of a mirror. She recommends CeraVe Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel, highlighting its lightweight gel texture and ability to lower skin temperature and provide hydration.

For a budget-friendly pre-makeup moisturizer, the speaker recommends Srichand Skin Moisture Burst Gel Cream. She describes the blue jar product as having a very thin, lightweight gel texture that focuses on water replenishment and calming the skin.

The video moves to category five for sensitive skin, showing women applying cream with towels on their heads. The speaker recommends La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Baume B5+, emphasizing its strength in restoring skin barrier balance during severe irritation or flare-ups.
The speaker recommends Dr.PONG CalmMea 1.5 Soothing Gel Cream for sensitive skin. She explains that it is a comfortable gel cream designed to soothe itchy, red, and sensitive skin conditions.

The speaker introduces category six focused on intense hydration and plumping, showing a woman applying eye cream. She recommends Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel, noting its gel texture provides great hydration and supports skin strength.

The speaker recommends LUNA HydroBiome Moisturizer for hydration, praising its ingredient list. She explains that it provides a full package of water replenishment, skin strengthening, and skin microbiome balancing.

The speaker presents category seven for all-in-one moisturizers, showing women with glowing skin. She recommends The Labatorian Oceans Beyond Moisturizer for water replenishment, skin strengthening, brightening, and anti-aging care.

The speaker offers alternative all-in-one options: Dr.Althea 345 Relief Cream for skin strength, moisture, and brightening, and Moleculology Starter Soft Cream for those seeking brightness and dark spot reduction.

In the concluding segment, the speaker asks viewers to comment on their favorite moisturizer from the video. She signs off by reminding viewers not to forget to comment and share their recommendations.
